message.content: LiHua expressed positive feedback regarding Hailey's new artisanal donuts. Specifically, LiHua stated that he tried the artisanal donuts and found them "amazing" with "unique and delicious" flavors. He highlighted his favorite as the chocolate hazelnut variety, noting that it had a "perfect balance of sweetness." LiHua was enthusiastic about the product, stating, "I really loved the chocolate hazelnut one! It had the perfect balance of sweetness. Can't wait to see what you come up with next! 😋" This feedback suggests that the chocolate hazelnut donut was particularly well-received, and Hailey likely intends to maintain or expand this flavor in future offerings.
